title: Senior Software Engineer - React Native
description:
**An Introduction to Codal**
 Codal is an award\-winning web design and development consultancy that helps enterprise organizations solve complex problems and accelerate growth through elegant, data\-driven digital solutions. Our areas of expertise include application modernization, eCommerce, UX/UI design, product strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence.
   

  

 At Codal, you will collaborate with some of the most innovative organizations in the world and work on cutting\-edge technologies that push the boundaries of design and software development. We promote long\-term success, not just for our clients but for our team, helping you develop a professional roadmap that takes your career to new heights.
   

  

**Experience Range**
 Overall Experience: 5–8\+ Years
   

  

 React Native Experience: 4\+ Years
   

  

 Leadership Experience: 1–2\+ Years (Code Reviews, Mentoring, Technical Ownership)
   

  

**Job Location** 
 \- Ahmedabad, Gujarat (WFO)
   

  

**Who You’ll Be Working With**
 We build the solutions dreamed up by the product and design teams. Our goal is to deliver working software every two weeks. We are a large team that spans across three global offices, but we collaborate and integrate front\- and back\-end components and interfaces to provide a user\-centered experience through web and mobile platforms.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native.
* Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable application components using TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
* Develop and integrate native functionality using Swift/SwiftUI for iOS and Kotlin for Android.
* Build and maintain Turbo Modules and native bridges to expose platform\-specific functionality to React Native.
* Work with Expo, including development, builds, and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) updates where applicable.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Optimize application performance, memory usage, startup time, and overall user experience across iOS and Android.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve production issues using monitoring and profiling tools.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and estimation sessions.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers by promoting engineering best practices.
* Integrate third\-party SDKs and platform services such as payments, analytics, authentication, push notifications, and maps.
* Publish and maintain applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including release management, code signing, provisioning profiles, and app submissions.
* Stay updated with the latest React Native ecosystem, mobile technologies, and industry best practices.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful (Requirements)**
 Must\-have Skills
   

  

* Strong experience building production applications using React Native.
* Proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience with state management libraries such as Redux Toolkit, Redux Saga, or Context API.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and handling asynchronous programming.
* Hands\-on experience with iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Hands\-on experience with Android development using Kotlin.
* Experience building and integrating native modules using Turbo Modules and native bridging.
* Experience with Expo, including development, builds, and OTA updates.
* Strong understanding of the React Native New Architecture, including Turbo Modules, JSI, and Fabric.
* Experience deploying and maintaining applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills for React Native applications.
* Experience using Git, pull request workflows, and code review practices.


**Should Have Skills**
* Experience with secure authentication, authorization, and data protection implementations.
* Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills across teams.
* Ability to recommend and implement technical and process improvements proactively.


**Nice To Have Skills**
* Modern Frontend: Experience with any JS framework Next/Nuxt or library ecosystems.
* Experience working with serverless, microservices, or monorepo architectures.
* Integrations: Prior experience integrating ERP systems or Payment Gateways with Shopware.
* Architecture: Experience with headless commerce architecture and Shopware B2B modules.


**Need another reason to hit the “apply” button?**
* Codal is a global agency with over 250 employees, and offices in the US, UK, Canada and India
* We are a BigCommerce Partner and have won the Partner of the year award twice (most recently this past year).
* We regularly host happy hours, dinners, excursions, and other company events to unwind after a hard day at work.
* Company sponsored lunch every Wednesday.
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical coverage for employees and their dependents
* Maternity/Paternity Leave: Additional time off and support for new parents
* Professional Development: Opportunities for training, workshops, conferences to enhance employees' skills and knowledge
* Accidental Insurance


 Note: Codal only communicates with candidates through official @codal.com email addresses. We never request payment during the hiring process. Please be vigilant regarding recruitment scams.
   

  

*At Codal, we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.*

title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Web Application \& Software Engineering**
* Architect \& Build Applications: Design, develop, and deploy responsive, high\-performance web applications using modern full\-stack frameworks (e.g., MERN, MEAN, LAMP, or Java/Spring Boot).
* API Development \& Integration: Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front\-end interfaces, back\-end systems, and third\-party tools.
* Database Management: Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non\-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high\-throughput, enterprise\-scale applications.


**Data Engineering \& Business Intelligence**
* ETL \& Data Pipeline Design: Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third\-party APIs.
* Dashboard \& Analytics Engineering: Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision\-making.
* Data Modeling \& Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.


**Enterprise Process Automation**
* Workflow Automation: Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end\-to\-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
* System Integration: Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.


**AI \& Emerging Technology Integration**
* Generative \& Agentic AI Solutions: Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
* AI Tooling \& Prompt Engineering: Build AI\-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.


**Cloud \& DevOps Operations**
* Cloud Architecture: Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
* CI/CD \& Code Hygiene: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skill Requirements**
**Hands\-on Experience**
* 4 to 8 years of core hands\-on experience in full\-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.


**Software \& Web Development Stack**
* Proficiency in at least one primary full\-stack development technology suite:
+ MERN / MEAN: React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
+ Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
+ LAMP / Web: PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**
* Experience in designing ETL/ELT processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
* Proficiency with both SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.


**Process Automation**
* Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud \& Desktop flows).


**Cloud Platforms**
* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.


**Teamwork, Communication \& Execution**
* Collaboration \& Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi\-disciplinary \& multi\-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
* Interpersonal \& Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non\-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
* Action\-Oriented \& Proactive: Highly self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.


**Preferred Experience**
* Generative \& Agentic AI:
+ Understanding of LLM/SLM fine\-tuning, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
+ Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function\-calling protocols.

* DevOps \& Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross\-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
* Problem\-Solving \& Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Primary Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
* Certifications (Desirable):
+ Cloud: Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
+ Analytics \& Automation: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL\-100/PL\-400\).

**Job description \& summary:** 



 PwC India is hiring SAP ABAP professionals across Associate, Senior Associate, Manager, and Senior Manager levels. We are looking for candidates with strong SAP ABAP development experience and exposure to SAP S/4HANA implementations.

* Develop, enhance, and support SAP ABAP solutions.


* Work on implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.


* Collaborate with functional teams and client stakeholders.


* Prepare technical designs, perform code reviews, and ensure quality delivery.


* Lead technical workstreams and mentor teams (Manager/Senior Manager).
